Name: Improved Standard Farm
Author: Coraxites
Description:
This is a mod which replaces the standard farm map with an identical one except for two differences:
- The big pond and the bottom of the map is replaced by normal earth
- The strange cliff that sticks out of the left-hand side is removed and also replaced with normal earth

I've tried my best to make it look as natural as I can. That being said I didn't give the new patches of dirt any debris at the start of the game, maybe in a future update.

This mod works on already created save files, but back-up just in case.

Requires: SMAPI and Content Patcher

Mods used for screenshots: Starblue Valley
